plugin.name: Samba Shares
plugin.description: Create and manage Samba (SMB) file shares, users and permissions on your hosts from one tab.

enable.label: Samba shares
enable.description: Show the Samba Shares tab for this host in its menu.

tab.title: Samba Shares
tab.noHost: Open Samba Shares from a host.
tab.error: Could not load Samba from this host.
tab.sudo: This host needs a root login or passwordless sudo to manage Samba.

install.title: Install Samba
install.desc: This installs Samba and the ACL tools with the host's package manager and starts the service.
install.empty: Samba is not installed on this host
install.noManager: No supported package manager was found. Install Samba by hand.
install.hint: Install it on {{os}} to share folders over SMB.

shares.deleteDesc: The share is removed from the config. The folder and its files stay on the host.
shares.externalNote: This share is defined in smb.conf. Change it there.
shares.browseableDesc: When off, people must type the share name to open it.
shares.readOnlyDesc: Nobody can change files, except users in the write list.
shares.guestDesc: Let people connect without a password.
shares.name: Share name
shares.makeFolderDesc: Make the folder if it does not exist and set who owns it.
shares.listHint: Names separated by spaces. Put @ before a group. Empty means everyone allowed.
shares.writeListHint: These users can change files even when the share is read only.
shares.inheritDesc: New files copy the permissions of the folder they are in.
shares.recycleDesc: Deleted files move to a .recycle folder in the share.

use.title: Use Samba Shares
use.description: Manage Samba shares, users and permissions on hosts you can edit.

permissions.loadFailed: Could not read the folder permissions.
permissions.missing: The folder {{path}} does not exist on the host.
permissions.recursiveDesc: Owner, mode and ACL changes also apply to all files and folders below.
permissions.noAcl: The ACL tools are not installed on this host.
permissions.name: Name

users.name: User name
users.existsHint: A Linux user with this name exists. It will get a Samba password.
users.createSystemDesc: Makes a Linux user without a login shell for this account.
users.deleteDesc: The Samba account is removed. The Linux user stays on the host.
users.title: Samba users

sessions.disconnectDesc: The client loses its connection. It can connect again.

config.managedHint: This file holds the shares made here. It is tested before it is used.
config.mainHint: Read only. The managed file is included at the end.

service.autostartDesc: Start Samba when the host starts.
service.notIncluded: smb.conf does not include the managed file yet. It is added the first time you save a share.
service.selinux: SELinux is on. To let Samba share any folder:
